follow-up time: until day of life 5 or until discharge, whichever is later
cohort: 1000 healthy term neonates (gestational age >=37 weeks) with an Apgar score of >=7 at first and fifth minutes of life.
finding: Cord blood albumin levels were inversely associated with the risk of developing significant neonatal jaundice, with neonates in the highest cord blood albumin group (>3.3 gm/dl) having the lowest risk.
